opportunities.name: Movie research (IMDb + Rotten Tomatoes) and email draft
opportunities.description: For a given movie, look up it on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, then compose a movie-night email to a friend with director, runtime, IMDb rating and Tomatometer.
steps: Search the movie title on IMDb and open its page
Search the same title on Rotten Tomatoes and open its page
Open mail compose, fill To, Subject, and Body with the summary
